claims.subject: rocket thrust regulation
claims.object: regulating propellant mass flow rate, since thrust varies approximately linearly with it
claims.statement: Hu et al. state that engine thrust varies with propellant mass flow rate approximately linearly, so regulating mass flow rates is the simplest way to regulate thrust; eight throttling approaches exist (high-pressure-drop, dual-manifold and variable-area injectors, gas injection, multiple chambers, pulse modulation, hydro-dynamically dissipative injectors, and combinations).
claims.quote: regulating the propellant mass flow rates is the simplest

claims.subject: injector pressure drop during throttling
claims.object: constant, by regulating mass flow and changing the injection area simultaneously
claims.statement: For atomization, combustion efficiency and adequate system resistance it is important to keep a constant injection pressure drop during throttling [7]; one effective method regulates propellant mass flow and changes the injection area simultaneously [8].
claims.quote: keep the injector with a constant injection pressure drop during the whole throttling process
